paper: AlphaCrafter: Harnessing Multi-Agent Workflows for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of AlphaCrafter's three-miner factor library, multi-horizon validation and maintenance, regime-aware diverse screener, signed factor ensemble, and top-K long-short trader; not the missing paper-time factor pool, LLM decisions, daily actions, or native return path.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: A cluster of miner agents proposes factors from market state, validates them on IC, RankIC, ICIR, hit ratio, coverage, turnover, and multiple horizons, persists accepted factors, and prunes decayed factors.
The screener diagnoses regime, uses recent ten-period mean RankIC for suitability, rejects weak or semantically similar factors at thresholds 0.02 and 0.8, and returns normalized directional weights.
The trader combines the factor ensemble with regime-conditioned strategy parameters, tests up to three configurations, and selects the highest-Sharpe feasible top-K long-short strategy.
The reference strategy ranks a weighted composite, trades top and bottom sets, constrains gross/net exposure, rebalances toward target holdings, and applies U.S. short/margin/cost mechanics.

workflow_policy.factor_weight: absolute recent mean RankIC normalized across selected factors, with direction equal to its sign
workflow_policy.regime_tilt: uptrend multiplies technical-miner suitability by 1.25; downtrend multiplies risk-reversal suitability by 1.25; fundamentals remain unchanged
workflow_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the dynamic signed ensemble score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

preserved_elements: periodic factor maintenance and decay pruning
approximated_elements: deterministic JKP candidate grammar replaces LLM factor generation
three miner themes replace model-specific prompts
rolling multi-horizon RankIC replaces unavailable native validation records
RankIC-series correlation replaces LLM semantic similarity
six-month market return replaces the regime-diagnosis LLM
fixed regime tilts replace generated screener instructions
the frozen common deciles replace trader hyperparameter/code search
monthly JKP inputs replace daily OHLCV/fundamental/news tools
invented_elements: the twelve miner seeds and signs
